scope: Additive SDK integration contract. This document is not final unified runtime or performance evidence.

rawExports.name: _pr_flow_host_rebase
rawExports.semantics: Subtract local shift. Aligned sparse addresses and atlas identities retained. No clock advancement. Failed admission does not write.

rawExports.name: _pr_flow_host_momentum_prepare
rawExports.semantics: Queues resident contact gather/readback; does not change gas/body velocities.

rawExports.name: _pr_flow_host_momentum_data
rawExports.semantics: Read only after flushing, waiting on the shared queue and copying completed readbacks. Pointer is not caller-owned; refresh heap views after growth.

rawExports.name: _pr_flow_host_momentum_commit
rawExports.semantics: Requires every admitted unique cell exactly once, unchanged w and finite f32 velocities. Validates all addresses/sequence/topology/frame before scatter. Conservation is the Engine solver responsibility.

hostMethods.name: commitPreparedMomentum
parameters: velocities:Vec3[] of exactly representable f32 values

types.tokenBrand: Tokens are opaque owner-bound WeakMap identities with frozen public views. Structurally equivalent objects are invalid; do not expose public constructors. Stale, reused, foreign, failed or concurrent tokens reject.
types.synchronize: Prevalidated synchronous coordinator only. It must not return a promise or throw. Native commits happen before the first await. A post-commit callback or GPU/device failure latches terminal fault; caller cannot claim rollback after a device fault.

updateFields: velocity xyz and preserved w:float32[4] at16

engine.bind: bind(body,{layer?:0,enabled?:true,paired?:pairedMomentum!==null}); paired requires finite owned dynamic native body and calibrated layer. Static/kinematic bodies remain one-way boundaries.
engine.rebaseReceipt: Host RebaseReceipt plus bodies:number and maximumPoseRoundingMetres:number.
engine.momentumReceipt: Host EXCHANGED fields plus mode:"terminal-paired-normal-impulses", scope:"terminal-normal-exchange-only", heatDisposition:"unapplied-explicit-obligation", heatObligationJ, densitiesKgPerM3, gasCells, bodies, sweeps, maximumClosingVelocity, appliedMaximumClosingVelocity, maximumRoundingVelocity, velocityTolerance, angularOriginMetres, ideal, applied, idealEnergyResidualJ, appliedEnergyResidualJ, budgets, linearError, angularError, energyError, kineticRoundingJ, roundingImpulseNs, roundingAngularImpulseNms.
engine.workLedger: ideal/applied each contain gasImpulseNs,bodyImpulseNs,gasAngularImpulseNms,bodyAngularImpulseNms as Vec3 and gasWorkJ,bodyWorkJ as f64.
engine.preparedOrigin: FloatingOrigin.prepareRebase/validatePreparedRebase/commitPreparedRebase are synchronous, single-use; flat and safe-number HierarchicalPosition advance together. Existing performRebase unchanged.

requiredIntegration: Same real ensurePhysXModule() instance for PhysX world and Flow; assert world.module === solver.module in unified proof.
One borrowed GPUDevice/queue; same completed physical clock, one Flow step per physical dt. Keep clock paused from prepare through synchronous native commit.
Await queue and readbacks before issuing tokens; revalidate body/geometry/config/cache/origin ownership before committing.
Include 124 kernels and exact reflection/header/source closure: original97,solid21,scalar4,momentum2.
Link only the hash-bound partial Flow object. Final loader/WASM manifest and served aliases must bind that exact component.
limitations: Terminal normal inelastic exchange is not a coupled pressure/advection/chemistry momentum proof.
heatObligationJ is not yet deposited into a thermal field. Normalized Flow temperature/smoke are not SI energy/density.
Exactness applies to atlas bytes and sparse integer identities. Float pose/source values retain finite representability; rebase receipt measures maximum rigid pose rounding.
BigInt regional streaming and arbitrary nonaligned shifts are not admitted.
No full GPU PhysX, realtime or multiple-device claim.
